hypothesis: τ(G) on all labeled simple graphs with n=5 vertices is enumerable (1024 graphs). Kirchhoff: any Laplacian cofactor. Deletion-contraction is an independent label oracle, not a second SGD architecture. Model K supplies the cofactor of a learned weighted Laplacian; SGD must learn 0-1 edge weights. Model A is the unstacked ReLU control on the same split.
output_classes: 0..125 inclusive (126-way). Observed τ values are 17 integers; unused bins stay in the readout.
architecture_K: w_e = scale_e x_e + bias_e, L from w, ĥ=det(L[1:,1:]), logits_k = -(ĥ-k)^2. Fixed readout. Xavier on scale, bias 0. No 0-1 init.
architecture_A: one-hidden ReLU MLP, width 8, input 10 edge bits, 126-way CE. No Laplacian.
protocol: held_edge e=(0,1) (graphs containing that edge are test). P=1024, 8000 Adam steps, lr=3e-3, seed=0, float32 domain_acc>=1.0. Do not relax the gate. K_5 is the unique graph with τ=125 and contains every edge, so class 125 is test-only; that is allowed. Do not raise n to 6. Do not train 3n+1.

tables.spanning_tau_destroyed: same graphs, labels a seed-20260910 permutation of the τ vector. Destroys Kirchhoff.

not_this_type: A recursive deletion-contraction network (not built; DC is a label check only).

certificate.C0_dc_equals_kirchhoff: Before training: deletion-contraction equals Kirchhoff on all 1024 graphs.
certificate.C1_domain_exact: float32 domain accuracy 1 on all 1024 graphs
certificate.C2_binarize_weights: w=scale x + bias, then w_bin=(w>=0.5). Cofactor of that 0-1 Laplacian equals τ on every graph, including the held edge. (Not a global (1,0) substitution: that would be Kirchhoff's theorem, independent of the net.)
certificate.C3_drop_one_edge: After snap, replace one edge's weights by independent {0,1} draws. Decoder must fail.
certificate.C4_adjacency_minor: det(A[1:,1:]) must not equal τ on all graphs. Wrong matrix.

predictions.P1_K_exact_exists: Model K on spanning_tau produces at least one domain-exact net (capacity).
predictions.P2_K_certified_not_guaranteed: Binarized-weight Kirchhoff may certify some exact K nets and may not. Presence is the measurement.
predictions.P3_destroyed_zero_certified: Model K on destroyed labels: n_certified=0. Exact nets there would not be Kirchhoff.
predictions.P4_A_not_kirchhoff: Model A on spanning_tau: n_certified=0 (no cofactor to snap). Exactness on the held-edge domain is not guaranteed.
predictions.P5_do_not_raise_n: If K n_certified=0, do not raise n to 6, do not add a recursive DC net, do not 0-1-init, do not loosen exactness.
predictions.P7_not_model_c: Do not score windings or CRT.

success_gate: The run completes under the locked protocol and scores P1–P5. Scientific Kirchhoff claim requires n_certified>0 on spanning_tau for Model K and n_certified=0 on destroyed. Zero on the genuine table is a valid miss.
decoder_sanity_before_training: C0 holds. Synthetic scale=1,bias=0 binarizes to x and certifies on spanning_tau; fails C2 on destroyed. C4 fails on the genuine table.
